Curved surface area of a cone = π × Radius × Slant Height

Diameter = Radius × 2

Calculation:

Radius of the base = 24 ÷ 2 = 12 cm

Let L and H be the slant height, and height of the clone respectively.

According to the question,

π × 12 × L = 1395(3)/(7)

⇒ L = 37

⇒ √(12² + H²) = 37

⇒ H = 35

**∴ The height of the cone is 35 cm.**

questions.question: Twelve years ago, the ratio of the ages of Anil and Bishu was 5 : 12. Eight years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 10 : 17. What is the ratio of the present ages of Anil and Bishu?
questions.solution:
Given:

12 Years ago the ratio of age, Anil : Bishu = 5 : 12

8 years after the ratio of age, Anil & Bishu = 10 : 17

Calculation:

Let the common ratio be Q.

Hence,

Anil's age 12 years ago = 5Q years

Bishu's age 12 years ago = 12Q years

According to the question,

(5Q + 12 + 8)/(12Q + 12 + 8) = 10/17

⇒ 85Q + 340 = 120Q + 200

⇒ 35Q = 140

⇒ Q = 4

Ratio of the present age of Anil & Bishu = (5 × 4 + 12) : (12 × 4 + 12) = 32 : 60 = 8 : 15

**∴ 8 : 15 is the ratio of the present ages of Anil and Bishu.**

questions.question: A man travelled a distance of 47 km in 6 hours. He travelled partly on foot at the rate of 6(1)/(2) km/h, and partly on bicycle at the rate of 8(1)/(2) km/h. The distance travelled on foot is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Total distance = 47 km

Total time taken = 6 hours

Speed on foot = 6(1)/(2) km/h i.e. 6.5 km

Speed on bicycle = 8(1)/(2) km/h i.e. 8.5 kmph

Concept used:

Distance = Time × Speed

Calculation:

Let the time he traveled on foot be Q hours.

Distance traveled by bicycle = (6 - Q) hours

According to the question,

6.5 × Q + 8.5 × (6 - Q) = 47

⇒ Q = 2

Hence, the distance traveled on foot = 6.5 × 2 = 13 km

**∴ The distance traveled on foot is 13 km.**

questions.question: If the ratio of the mode and median of a certain data is 9 : 8, then the ratio of its mean and median is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Mode : Median = 9 : 8

Concept used:

Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

Calculation:

Let the common ratio be Q.

Hence,

Mode = 9Q

Median = 8Q

According to the question,

Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

⇒ 9Q = 24Q - 2Mean

⇒ Mean = 7.5Q

Now, Mean : Median = 7.5Q : 8Q = 15 : 16

**∴ The ratio of its mean and median is 15 : 16.**

questions.question: If the height of a cylinder is increased by 30%, and the radius of its base is decreased by 15%, then by what percentage will its curved surface area change?
questions.solution:
Given:

The height of a cylinder is increased by 30%, and the radius of its base is decreased by 15%

Concept used:

The curved surface area of a cylinder = 2πRH unit2

R, H being the base radius and height respectively. 

Calculation:

Let the radius of the base and height be R and H units respectively. 

Hence, Original curved surface area = 2πRH unit²

Now,

Increased height = H + H × 30% = 1.3H units

Decreased base radius = R - R × 15% = 0.85R units

Final curved surface area = 2π × 0.85R × 1.3H = 2.21πRH units.

% change = (2.21πRH - 2πRH)/2πRH × 100% = 10.5%

**∴ By 10.5% its curved surface area will change. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**One increment of 30% and one decrement of 15% have taken place.

Hence, final % change = 30 - 15 - (30 × 15)/100 = 10.5%

∴ By 10.5% its curved surface area will change.

questions.question: A's monthly salary is 20% more than B's monthly salary. C's monthly salary is ₹25,000 more than B's monthly salary. Their total monthly salary is ₹2,65,000. The salary of B is what percentage of that of C?
questions.solution:

Their total monthly salary is ₹2,65,000.

Application of Percentage

Calculation:

Let the salary of B is Rs. Q.

A's monthly salary = Q + Q × 20% = Rs. 1.2Q

C's monthly salary = Q + 25000

According to the question,

Q + 1.2Q + Q + 25000 = 265000

⇒ Q = 75,000

B's monthly salary = Rs. 75,000

C's monthly salary = (75000 + 25000) = Rs. 1,00,000

% = 75,000/1,00,000 × 100 = 75%

**∴ The salary of B is 75% of that of C.**

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 12 days for 6 hours per day, and B can do it in 8 days for 7 hours per day. How long will they take to do the work, working together, for 9 hours a day?
questions.solution:
Given: 

A can do a piece of work in 12 days for 6 hours per day.

B can do it in 8 days for 7 hours per day. 

Concept used:

Work = Working Hours × Units done per hour × Time taken to finish entire work (in days)

Calculation:

Let A & B complete P & Q units of work hourly respectively.

According to the question,

12 × P × 6 = 8 × Q × 7

⇒ P/Q = 7/9

Let the common ratio be G.

Hence, A & B completes 7G & 9G units of work hourly respectively.

Time taken to finish the work entirely together working for 9 hours a day = (12 × 7G × 6) ÷ {(7G + 9G) × 9} = 7/2 days 

**∴ They will take 7/2 days to do the work, working together, for 9 hours a day.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** 

Time taken by A to complete the work = 12 *6 = 72 hours

Time taken by B to complete the work = 8 * 7 = 56 hours

Let the total work = LCM of (A,B) = 504 units

Work done per hour by A = 7 units

Work done per hour by B = 9 units

when working together they will complete = 7+ 9 = 16 units per hour

work done per day together = 9 * 16 = 144 units

Number of days taken = 504 / 144 = 7 / 2

∴ They will take 7/2 days to do the work, working together, for 9 hours a day.

questions.question: Varun can do a work in 28 days. In how many days can the work be completed by Sarvesh, if the efficiency of Sarvesh is 40% more than that of Varun?
questions.solution:
Given:

Varun takes 28 days to complete the work.

Sarvesh is 40% more efficient than Varun.

Concept used:

Work = Units done daily × Total time taken to complete the work (in days)

Calculation:

Let Varun does Q units per day.

Total work = 28 × Q = 28Q units

So, Sarvesh daily does = Q + Q × 40% = 1.4Q

 Time taken by Sarvesh to complete the work alone = 28Q ÷ 1.4Q = 20 days

**∴ Sarvesh will take 28 days to complete the work.**

questions.question: Instead of dividing ₹3,910 among P, Q and R in the ratio (1)/(4):(1)/(5):(1)/(8), by mistake it was divided in the ratio 4 : 5 : 8. By how much did R gain in this transaction?
questions.solution:
Given: 

Sum to be divided = Rs. 3910

Right ratio = (1)/(4):(1)/(5):(1)/(8)

Wrong ratio = 4 : 5 : 8

Concept used:

Ratio Proportion

Calculation:

Mentioned right ratio 

⇒ (1)/(4):(1)/(5):(1)/(8)

⇒(1/4 × 40) : (1/5 × 40) : (1/8 × 40)

⇒ 10 : 8 : 5

Correct share of R = 5/(10 + 8 + 5) × 3910 = Rs. 850

Share that R got because of the mistake = 8/(4 + 5 + 8) × 3910 = Rs. 1840

Gain of R = (1840 - 850) = Rs. 990

**∴ By Rs. 990 R gained in this transaction. **
